rolesPage.title: Roles & Permissions
rolesPage.intro: Head office is a role and the absence of a branch, both at once. An administrator pinned to a branch is that branch’s administrator — they read as the middle column here, not the right-hand one.
rolesPage.footer: A branch account is answered about its own branch whatever it asks for — the confinement holds at the API, not only in the branch switcher. Head office asking for nothing in particular gets every site.

caps.shift: Open, count and close a till
caps.refundNote: A cashier raises the refund; it only moves once an approver puts a pin in.
caps.availability: Suspend an item that ran out today
caps.overridesNote: Only for the groups head office has opened up; the rest are inherited and read-only.
caps.terminals: Register a till or card terminal
caps.printers: Set up printers and ticket routing
caps.reportsNote: A branch manager’s reports cover their own site. Head office sees every site.
caps.catalog: Write the menu — products, categories, modifiers
caps.catalogNote: A branch sees the catalogue and decides what it can serve today. It does not author it.
caps.authority: Set discount caps and approval thresholds
caps.users: Hire, move and deactivate staff — and set their pin
caps.usersNote: Anyone may change their own pin. Setting somebody else’s is head office’s.
caps.branches: Open a branch, set its trading hours
caps.fleetRollup: See every branch’s couriers on one screen
caps.shiftRollup: See every branch’s tills, and the drawers left open
